selection: Eight new regularized quadratic configurations and exact reused language control. Select pooled inner correct count, macro-F1, declared order. Full-data config selected from cached inner predictions only.
features: Original semantic_AV512 features and 16 fixed age-free language features. No questionnaire answers, scores, demographics, participant IDs or labels enter inference features.
preprocessing: Fitting-only base scaling/PCA8 or16; language scaling; concatenated-coordinate scaling. Shared covariance shrunk toward diagonal; class-specific diagonal variance pooled with ten fitting-participant equivalents. Fixed sqrt-frequency priors match effective original sqrt class weighting. No resampling.
evaluation: 163 original training participants, original5 outer/3 inner folds, seeds42/137/2026. Reuse control checkpoints; no previous failed fits. No validation/test scoring. Exploratory comparison after long experiment history.
motivation: Mild and Moderate errors concentrate in majority predictions; a strongly regularized class-dependent covariance permits curved boundaries absent from linear logistic and prior shared-covariance LDA. This hypothesis is not a claim that errors are proven heteroscedastic.
stopping_rule: One new model family, eight frozen configurations; no post-result grid expansion or threshold tuning.
